'''Fallanter Gest''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Quesh war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], Gest was stationed at the [[Imperial Garrison (Quesh)|Imperial Garrison]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fallanter Gest appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Imperial players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
